name: Margin Rate Portfolio 1
definition: Specifies long and short margin rates for a defined portfolio.

LongMarginRate.name: Long Margin Rate
LongMarginRate.definition: Margin charged on a portfolio where the value of the contract increases when the value of the underlying increases.

ShortMarginRate.name: Short Margin Rate
ShortMarginRate.definition: Margin charged on a portfolio where the value of the contract decreases when the value of the underlying increases.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Description of the fixed portfolio used for the purposes of the calculation.
